name: mediterranean-yacht-sunset-man
image_purpose: Luxury travel and menswear lifestyle content

prompt.project_info: Create a refined Mediterranean yacht lifestyle portrait for social media.
prompt.main_subject: One generic approved adult man in his late 20s or early 30s, short dark hair and neatly groomed beard, wearing a beige linen blazer, navy-and-white striped T-shirt, white linen trousers, olive belt, and dark aviator sunglasses.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical portrait framing from mid-thigh upward on the deck of a wooden sailboat. The man stands naturally near the rigging, looking toward the sunlit horizon. Include soft sea bokeh, sailboat details, and a few distant indistinct passengers in the background.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Golden-hour Mediterranean sunlight, warm rim light, sparkling water highlights, gentle sea breeze, relaxed premium holiday atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic vertical social-media portrait, natural skin texture, realistic fabric and hair, accurate sunglasses reflections, shallow depth of field, no readable branding or watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Photorealistic vertical Mediterranean yacht lifestyle portrait, one generic approved adult man late 20s to early 30s with short dark hair and a neat beard, beige linen blazer over a navy-and-white striped T-shirt, white linen trousers, olive belt, dark aviator sunglasses, standing naturally on the deck of a wooden sailboat, sea and rigging behind him, sparkling Mediterranean water, warm golden-hour sunlight, soft background bokeh, refined aspirational travel editorial mood, realistic anatomy and fabric, no logos, no watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized pose, fetish styling, nudity, minors, celebrity likeness, public-figure likeness, distorted anatomy, extra fingers, malformed hands, duplicate subject, warped sunglasses, unreadable text, logos, watermark

assets.name: mediterranean-yacht-sunset-man reference
assets.usage: Match the adult subject styling, sailboat setting, standing pose, warm light, and Mediterranean palette while keeping the identity generic and replaceable.

Keep identity, clothing details, accessories, passengers, and environment replaceable. Remove incidental logos and watermarks.
